## Recent work

**AI engineer — Alef Education**
Building an agentic AI teacher supporting assistant. This involves designing and implementing multi-agent systems that support teachers in the classroom, working at the intersection of large language models, education, and practical deployment.

**Computerised adaptive testing — assessments**
Designing and building CAT systems and advising on psychometrics, primarily using item response theory. Work spans system architecture, model selection, and translating technical findings for non-specialist stakeholders.
